tag: The Devi's eyes, on a Shivalik hilltop.
sub: One of the five Shakti Peeths of Himachal — in Suzu Travels' home district. The legend, darshan hours, the cable car, Navratri crowds and the easiest ways to reach the temple.
q: Where is Naina Devi temple and why is it sacred?
answer: Shri Naina Devi Ji stands on a Shivalik hilltop in Bilaspur district, Himachal Pradesh, above the Gobind Sagar lake, about 100 km from Chandigarh. Tradition counts it among the Shakti Peeths: it is believed that Sati's eyes fell here. It is open from about 5 am to 9 pm and is busiest in Navratri.

story.lead: Two traditions meet on this hilltop — the fall of Sati's eyes, and a herd boy named Naina.
beats: When Shiva carried Sati's body through the worlds, Vishnu's chakra divided it; her eyes are believed to have fallen on this hill.
Centuries later, a Gujjar herd boy saw a white cow pouring its milk over a stone.
The Goddess told him in a dream that the stone was her pindi.
Raja Bir Chand built the shrine and named it after him — Naina Devi.
more: Another strand of the legend links the name to the Devi taking the eyes of the demon Mahishasura — which is why the shrine is also called Mahishapeeth.

cards: Chandigarh airport is about 100 km away; Shimla airport about 170 km.
Anandpur Sahib (about 20–30 km) and Kiratpur Sahib (about 30 km) are the nearest stations.
About 100 km from Chandigarh and 350–370 km from Delhi; from Bilaspur town about 56 km.
A cable car lifts pilgrims from the base of the hill to the temple. The long-proposed Anandpur Sahib ropeway has not been built yet.

faqs: Which part of Sati fell at Naina Devi?
Tradition says her eyes — 'naina' means eyes. Some accounts specify the right eye; the Naina Devi temple in Nainital has its own 'eyes' tradition.
What are Naina Devi temple timings?
About 5 am to 9 pm, with longer hours during the Navratri and Shravan melas. Aarti times are not published officially, so confirm at the temple.
Is there a ropeway to Naina Devi?
Yes, a cable car runs from the base of the hill to the hilltop temple. A longer ropeway from Anandpur Sahib has been proposed for years but not built.
How far is Naina Devi from Chandigarh?
About 100–106 km by road, roughly 2.5 hours. The nearest railway stations are Anandpur Sahib and Kiratpur Sahib.
When is Naina Devi most crowded?
In Chaitra and Sharad Navratri (Sharad Navratri 2026 begins on 11 October) and at the Shravan Ashtami fair in July–August.
Which other Shakti Peeths are near Naina Devi?
Chintpurni (Una), Jwala Ji, Brajeshwari (Kangra Devi) and Chamunda (Kangra) — together they make the five Shakti Peeths of Himachal.
